purpose: Post-review descriptive separation of training-representation and test-input contrasts using original saved B/C estimators; preserve original cases, roles, recipes and scientific holds.
exposure: Historical domains and earlier diagonal results already exposed; not preregistered independent confirmation, chronological forecasting or a causal field intervention.

source_authority.model_subset_rule: For each original inventory cohort retain exactly entries whose first path component is B_uniform_pixels or C_core_weighted. The archived source model file must match its recorded byte length and SHA256 before deserialization. No refit or replacement.

train_arm_definition: Arm of the original saved fitted model; parameters/scaler/feature order and fit-reference fixed.
test_arm_definition: B or C representation from the matching frozen positional test snapshot of that cohort, same fold and fit-reference. Only NDVI may differ between test arms; identities, meteorology and reference labels must agree.

principal.primary_estimand: Equal-site-season mean of four site-season RMSEs, each weight1/4. Same original LOYO predictions/test roles; do not average repeated axes.
principal.all_supported_axes: Retain all five supported fold instances; Ro1 LOSO/joint/LOYO share membership and are not independent replications.

T1.primary_estimand: Equal-test-site-season mean of three original earlier-year Mead site-seasons, each weight1/3; keep separate from principal.

preserved_controls: Original positional train/test indices and their ID hashes
Eight original predictors and feature order
Both dependent original processed GPP scoring references

prediction_policy.serialized_model_validation: Check source SHA and original protocol hash, feature columns, target, seed, train/test IDs, n_train/n_test against frozen plan before inference.
prediction_policy.constant_and_calendar: Replay train_mean from saved constant; replay seasonal_harmonic with original calendar_matrix; use original saved estimator.predict for learned families. No fit call permitted.

cell_definition: R_te denotes RMSE or the explicitly labelled mean of per-unit RMSEs for original model trained on arm t and evaluated on test input e; first index=train, second=test. B/C cell contrasts are computed within the same cohort/axis/model/fitref/scoreref/estimand.
interpretation: All contrasts are conditional computational comparisons. Interaction may be nonzero; no unique additive causal allocation is claimed. Scalar RMSE nonlinearities and aggregation choices remain explicit.

units.normalized_contrasts: Optional100*contrast/R_BB common-baseline percentage points within the identical metric/unit. Do not add condition-specific percentages with different denominators.
units.negative_sign: Lower RMSE for the first-named arm condition.

aggregation_policy.primary: Equal-site-season mean RMSE on principal LOYO and separate T1; calculate each cell's metric before conditional differences.
aggregation_policy.sensitivity: Equal-region pooled RMSE and pooled-day RMSE separately labelled; do not attribute their differences to weights alone.
aggregation_policy.score_paths: Primary narrative retains both original own-fit/own-score paths; provide full2fit×2score outputs without selecting a preferred path.
aggregation_policy.replication: Repeated fold roles and score expansions do not create additional physical days, independent sites or regions.

verification.diagonal: BB and CC predictions must reproduce original frozen B/C diagonal rows. Report exact equality and maximum difference; hard tolerance1e-10 if needed with reason, never silently relax.
verification.ro1: For each fixed trained estimator and reference, all Ro1 B/C test features identical ⇒ p_tB = p_tC exactly; test-input contrasts zero. Training contrasts may differ.
verification.optical_free: Train mean and seasonal harmonic B/C train/test predictions exactly equal within same fold/reference.
verification.reference_score: For fixed fitted model and test arm, predictions must be invariant across scoring-reference expansion.
verification.pairing: Same record keys, dates, weather and labels across test arms; preserve frozen row order/positional ID hashes.
verification.numeric: Full cell/contrast/interaction identities checked before averaging and after labelled aggregation, tolerance1e-10; independent verifier must not import production scoring.
verification.source_integrity: Before/after hashes of all consumed snapshots/protocols/folds/original prediction tables/models; original files read-only.
verification.no_selection: All specified cases, families, references, supported axes and contrasts retained including adverse/near-zero results.

statistics: Descriptive finite-domain contrasts only. No p-values, population CIs, daily independent bootstrap, universal superiority or new sealed-test claim.
publication: New analysis version/SI/tables/figures; v0.8 and original model/data releases unchanged. Public availability/licensing and author/funding/COI remain separate.
